description: Deterministic conservative scorecard rules. Every finalized provision receives exactly +1 or -1; comparable prior enacted laws are recorded as the current-law reference and ideological fallback rules are used when no comparable law exists.

calibrated_rules.rationale: Defunding/cutting veterans affairs is neutral (0) by user decision and is not scored.
Gun-rights/open-carry expansion is socially conservative and right of the current baseline.
Expands legal abortion relative to the conservative baseline.
Adds/retains regulatory standards; the bill's own report shows regulatory burden falling, but the provision establishes environmental regulation rather than deregulation.
Raises a government-mandated wage floor above the federal baseline.
Veterans affairs funding/benefits are scored +1 (aligned) by user decision, as a national-defense and veterans commitment.
Expanding H-1B skilled-worker immigration moves policy leftward under the nationalist framework.
Creates universal federal healthcare and increases federal program scope/regulatory burden.
Creates an additional industry tax.
Anti-communist nationalism is rightward under the specified framework; civil-liberties costs do not reverse the direction.
Adds a federal holiday and expands federally facilitated voting access; it is not a rightward law-and-order/nationalist movement.
Expands federal political representation and is treated as a moderate-liberal institutional expansion under the calibrated framework.
Expands union financial privileges and a tax preference rather than deregulating private enterprise.
National-security restriction on a foreign-linked platform is rightward under nationalism/hemispheric-security priorities; civil-liberties effects do not reverse it.
Independent anti-corruption oversight advances the transparency/law-and-order priority.

calibrated_rules.pattern: ^intelligence community budget authority: full program authority$
calibrated_rules.rationale: Strengthens intelligence capability and national defense without itself authorizing overseas intervention.
GI Bill/veterans benefits are scored +1 (aligned) by user decision.

calibrated_rules.pattern: ^authorization for use of military force: afghanistan & al-qa$
calibrated_rules.rationale: Authorizes overseas military action; the framework is generally anti-intervention and distinguishes defense readiness from military projection.
Recognizes same-sex civil unions rather than maintaining the social-conservative marriage baseline.
Expands same-sex marriage recognition relative to the social-conservative baseline.
Mandated comprehensive sex education expands government-directed social policy.
Large-scale immigration expansion is leftward under the nationalist framework.
Government subsidy expansion is leftward under fiscal libertarianism, even when the underlying energy source is favorable.
Strengthens law-and-order enforcement against violent crime.
Expands federal land/environmental regulation rather than reducing government scope.
Expands federal subsidies and spending.
Expands the electorate to minors and is not a nationalist/law-and-order rightward movement.
Creates a large federal education benefit.
Creates a universal government-funded benefit.
Adds a substantial new tax.
A tax credit reduces taxes and is rightward under the fiscal-libertarian rule.
Expands a federal entitlement benefit.
Binary fallback for a provision labeled neutral by the source; retained for deterministic no-zero scoring and flagged for review.
Expands/reorganizes a federal energy research program rather than reducing government scope.
Creates/expands a federal infrastructure spending program.
Strengthens border enforcement and nationalism.

calibrated_rules.pattern: ^small business support: expanded sba & tax relief$
calibrated_rules.rationale: Expanded SBA support increases federal spending; the tax-relief component does not erase the spending expansion under the calibrated equal-provision rule.
Raises a government-mandated wage floor.
Deregulation is rightward under fiscal libertarianism; civil-rights tradeoffs do not reverse the rightward policy direction.
Binary fallback for an unknown provision; retained for deterministic no-zero scoring and flagged for review.
Anything related to veterans affairs is scored +1 (aligned) by user decision.

general_rules.pattern: \b(assault rifles?|firearms?|pistols?|open carry|concealed carry|gun rights|second amendment).*(allowed|legal|permitless|unrestricted)|\b(open carry|gun rights|firearm rights)\b
general_rules.rationale: Gun-rights expansion is socially conservative.

general_rules.pattern: \b(assault weapons? ban|gun control|firearms? ban|pistols?: banned|universal background checks|magazine ban)\b
general_rules.rationale: Gun restrictions move left of the conservative baseline.
Abortion restriction is socially conservative.
Expanding abortion access is socially liberal.

general_rules.pattern: \b(death penalty|capital punishment|mandatory minimum|violent offender|sex offender|police funding|law and order)\b
general_rules.rationale: Strengthens law-and-order policy.

general_rules.pattern: \b(illegal immigration|deportation|border enforcement|immigration restriction|visa cap|immigration cap|amnesty ban)\b
general_rules.rationale: Restrictive immigration policy is nationalist/rightward.
Expanding immigration moves left of the nationalist baseline unless explicitly calibrated otherwise.
Protects religious liberty under the social-conservative framework.

general_rules.pattern: \b(new tax|tax increase|raise.*tax|excise tax|wealth tax|corporate tax increase)\b
general_rules.rationale: Tax increases move away from fiscal libertarianism.
Tax reduction is fiscally libertarian.
Spending restraint and deficit reduction are fiscally libertarian.

general_rules.pattern: \b(new federal program|government spending|public spending|appropriation increase|subsidy|government grant|universal benefit|federal benefit)\b
general_rules.rationale: Expanding federal spending moves away from fiscal libertarianism.
Deregulation is rightward under fiscal libertarianism.
Additional federal regulation is leftward under fiscal libertarianism.
Government-mandated wage floors are leftward.
Protectionism is an explicit exception to the otherwise libertarian economic framework.
Expanding union privileges is leftward under the economic framework.

general_rules.pattern: \b(defense spending|military readiness|armed forces|defense authorization|military modernization|intelligence capability|homeland defense)\b
general_rules.rationale: Supports a strong military without necessarily requiring overseas projection.
Anti-communism is explicitly rightward in the foreign-policy framework.
Hemispheric action against communist threats is explicitly permitted by the framework.

general_rules.pattern: \b(military intervention|foreign intervention|invasion|occupation|regime change|overseas military action|authorization for use of military force)\b
general_rules.rationale: The framework is generally anti-intervention and distinguishes military strength from projection.
Foreign assistance is generally disfavored under the anti-intervention framework unless specifically anti-communist/hemispheric and calibrated otherwise.
Weakening military capability is leftward under the strong-defense framework.
Greater government transparency is explicitly a scorecard priority.
